# Standard library: memory, containers and concurrency

<!-- Generated by skill/plutonium/tools/genstdlib from lib/pluto. Do not edit; regenerate. -->

Allocators, arenas, growable and fixed containers, sorting, iteration, tasks and locks.

Listing of the hosted build (linux, amd64): every exported name, one line each, with the
ownership kind of each type (`value`, `view`, `owner (moves)`, `counted`; see section 8.7). Methods are
indented under their type. For the full comment of a name run `pluto doc pluto/strings Cut` or
`pluto doc pluto/vec Vec.Push`. `(*T)` is a pointer receiver (borrows); `(T)` on an owner type
consumes the receiver.

Packages in this file: `pluto/alloc`, `pluto/alloc/debug`, `pluto/arena`, `pluto/vec`, `pluto/hash`, `pluto/container`, `pluto/container/heap`, `pluto/slices`, `pluto/sort`, `pluto/iter`, `pluto/sync`, `pluto/sync/atomic`.

## pluto/alloc

Package alloc provides heap allocation: the default allocator, a slab allocator, and typed allocation functions.

```

  // An Allocator provides zeroed memory and takes it back.

  // A PageProvider supplies whole pages of zeroed memory.

  func (r Restore) Restore()

  func (s *SyncSlab) Alloc(size, align uintptr) unsafe.Pointer
  func (s *SyncSlab) Free(p unsafe.Pointer, size, align uintptr)
```

## pluto/alloc/debug

Package debug provides a checking allocator that catches heap misuse deterministically: overflows past either end of an allocation, use after free, double and invalid frees, and leaks.

```
const: CanaryByte, PoisonByte
const LeakMode: LeaksFail, LeaksOff, LeaksReport
type Allocator struct { _ unexported }  [view]
  // An Allocator is the checking allocator.
  func (d *Allocator) Alloc(size, align uintptr) unsafe.Pointer
  func (d *Allocator) CheckHeap()
  func (d *Allocator) Free(p unsafe.Pointer, size, align uintptr)
  func (d *Allocator) ReportLeaks() int
  func (d *Allocator) Stats() Stats
type LeakMode int  [value]
  // LeakMode says what happens at exit to allocations still live.
type Options struct { Pages alloc.PageProvider; Underflow bool; CanaryBelow uintptr; MaxGuarded int; Quarantine uintptr; Leaks LeakMode }  [view]
  // Options configure an Allocator.
type PageProtector interface { ProtectPages(p unsafe.Pointer, n uintptr, access bool) bool }  [view]
  // A PageProtector is a page provider that can change the access to its pages.
type Stats struct { Live        int; LiveBytes   uintptr; Quarantined int; Guarded     int; Allocs      uint64 }  [value]
  // Stats describe an Allocator's current state.
func DefaultOptions() Options
func DescribeFault(addr, pc uintptr, write bool) bool
func EnvOptions() Options
func New(opts Options) *Allocator
```

## pluto/arena

Package arena provides fixed-capacity and growing bump allocators. Fixed and Chunked own their private backing and check allocation lifetimes in checked builds. NewUnsafe instead borrows a caller-provided buffer; its Arena has manually managed lifetimes (language spec section 18.12).

## pluto/container

Package container declares the constraints of the indexing interface (language spec section 11.11), for generic code over library containers.

```
type Indexable[K, V any] interface { Index(k K) V; SetIndex(k K, v V) }  [view]
  // Indexable is a container whose elements can be read and assigned with x[k] and x[k] = v.
type Iterable[K, V any] interface { All() iter.Seq2[K, V] }  [view]
  // Iterable is a container that can be ranged over, for k, v := range x, which ranges over x.All().
type Lookup[K, V any] interface { IndexOk(k K) (V, bool) }  [view]
  // Lookup is a container that reports whether it holds a key, with v, ok := x[k].
type Reader[K, V any] interface { Index(k K) V }  [view]
  // Reader is a container whose elements can be read with x[k].
type Sized interface { Len() int }  [view]
  // Sized is a container with a length, len(x).
```

## pluto/container/heap

Package heap provides heap operations for any type that implements heap.Interface, and Heap, a generic heap in a vec.Vec. A heap is a tree with the property that each node is the minimum-valued node in its subtree.


## pluto/sync

Package sync provides mutual exclusion locks, wait groups, one-time initialisation and condition variables, as Go's sync package does (language spec section F.5, memory-model.md section 3.4).

```
type Cond struct { L Locker; _ unexported }  [view]
  // A Cond is a condition variable: a point at which tasks wait for, or announce, an event.
```
